channel.title: The Dig — Application benchmarks
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Application benchmarks preset. Today's ranked reading list leads with 2611.30931, a must-read on calibration-insensitive spin-qubit pulses that sustain high fidelity and stable rotation angles under drift, followed by 2611.29983 on a high-performance quantum software stack relevant to compilation and device adaptation; the remaining skims cover resource-efficient QAOA for Max-k-Cut in 2611.30508, low-energy subspace sampling for quantum optimization in 2611.32560, and the DOE quantum-supercomputing integration roadmap in 2611.31514.
